# cloudsmith_policy_list (Data Source)

List policies in a Cloudsmith workspace, filtered by a required query.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `query` (String) Search query (e.g. 'name:my-policy').
- `workspace` (String) Workspace to list policies for.

### Optional

- `sort` (String) Sort field (e.g. 'created_at', '-created_at', 'name', '-name').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `policies` (List of Object) The list of policies matching the query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_terminal` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `precedence` (Number)
- `read_only` (Boolean)
- `rego` (String)
- `slug_perm` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number)
